capabilities: List frontmatter property names and distinct values with counts
Filter properties and values from a top input
Search notes by property or by property/value pair
Rename or delete a property across matching notes
Rename or delete a value across matching notes
extras: Rename and delete change frontmatter in matching notes after confirmation but have no undo history; counts come from the metadata cache, so recent changes may need a refresh; the plugin reads all markdown files locally and sends them nowhere.
intentEvidence: It feels like Obsidian's All Properties panel, with one extra step
problem: Obsidian's Properties view shows property names but not the distinct values used across the vault, so spotting inconsistent or stray values means checking notes one by one.
summary: Sidebar view that lists frontmatter properties and their distinct values with counts, plus search, rename and delete actions.
